# Packages whose install test is replaced by a source preparation test in
# ebuild-ci.yml. Their build dependencies are not in the stage3 image, so
# `ebuild clean install` cannot succeed there. `clean unpack prepare` still
# checks the distfiles, their digests and the patches.
#
# One package per line: category/package, then the reason, which must not
# contain '#' or '|'. Packages not listed here are installed in CI. Remove an
# entry once CI can provide what the package needs.
dev-python/comfy-aimdo needs cmake and setuptools-scm to build
dev-python/comfy-kitchen needs gpep517 and setuptools for the PEP 517 build; CUDA builds also need nanobind, cmake, ninja and nvcc; DEPEND also pulls PyTorch
